name: Group Header 134
definition: Set of characteristics shared by all individual notifications included in the message.

MessageIdentification.name: Message Identification
MessageIdentification.definition: Point to point reference, as assigned by the sender, and sent to the receiver to unambiguously identify the message.|Usage: The sender has to make sure that MessageIdentification is unique per receiver for a pre-agreed period.

CreationDateTime.name: Creation Date Time
CreationDateTime.definition: Date and time at which the message was created.
